name: split-button
title: Split button
description: One control frame, two cells: the action and its menu. The menu docks to the frame.
whenToUse: Use it when one action is usual and a few alternatives belong with it. For unrelated commands use Menu or Button group.

parts.name: SplitButton
parts.description: The frame: a group of the action cell and the menu's caret cell.

props.name: layout
props.description: cell: a cell of an enclosing frame (e.g. a bulk bar).

parts.name: SplitButtonAction
parts.description: The action cell: Base UI's Button.

parts.name: SplitButtonPopup
parts.description: The menu's popup: MenuPopup docked to the whole frame, taking the frame's weight on the shared edge.

parts.name: SplitButtonTrigger
parts.description: The caret cell that opens the menu: Base UI's Menu.Trigger. Its children replace the caret.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element. The caret shows no text: say what the menu holds ("More booking options").
